summary: BANGKOK: Car production in Thailand rose 10.93% in August from a year earlier to 124,646 units, the Federation of Thai Industries said on Monday. The reading follows a rise of 6.12% in July. title: Saudi foreign minister arrives in Washington for talks with Rubio
summary: DUBAI: Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan arrived in Washington on Monday for talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio , the Saudi state news agency said, amid escalating hostilities between Riyadh and Yemen’s Houthis. The two will discuss bilateral ties as well as key regional and international developments, the agency added. Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman sought US military help this month against the Houthis, but Washington declined to launch strikes, though it agreed to supply intelligence and targeting support, sources had told Reuters .
